content: Incorporating a systematic approach to assess, adopt, and integrate technology into diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES) can significantly enhance access to care and promote equitable health outcomes for individuals with diabetes. Technology-enabled solutions, such as virtual health platforms, digital coaching programs, and continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) systems, are being increasingly utilized to assist patients in managing their diabetes. These tools provide patients with the ability to monitor their glucose levels in real time and receive immediate feedback, which can improve their self-management capabilities.
